description: QA of the existing locale files against the source locale, without translating: no network, no API key, read-only. Use after babelize_translate or after editing locale files, and before committing. Finds: missing and stale keys; empty values; values identical to the source (untranslated); placeholders/tags lost or invented ({name}, {{count}}, <0>, %s); invalid ICU messages and wrong plural categories for the locale (ICU and i18next _one/_other keys); glossary violations (glossary in .babelize/config.json). Looks for <locale>.json (or <locale>/<namespace>.json) under locales/, messages/, lang/, i18n/ or translations/ folders. Returns per-locale counts and a capped list of issues (errors first) with file, locale, key and the problem in plain words.

locales.description: Only check these target locales (default: every locale file found).

minSeverity.description: Lowest severity to list (default "warning"; counts always include everything).

path.description: Project directory, relative to the workspace root (default: the workspace root). Must stay inside the workspace.

name: babelize_check
title: Check locale files (QA)
